checks: VR preparation opens in gyro mode with the fusion tools hidden
Fusion preparation accepts a proven pair and persists the selected mode
Fresh gyro samples plus calibrated markers enable the real VR start button
Landscape VR is pure stereo 3D with no HUD, reticle, captions or exit button
Gaze focus earns the first of three searches and decays only to that earned segment
Ten seconds of bin focus reveals a find and locks the courtyard
Head turns and nods rotate only the find while the locked camera stays still
Two no swings auto-save the find and return to searching
Leaving VR during inspection still auto-saves the current find
The 18th VR find defers the normal completion dialog until after exit
Portrait uses the single-eye fallback and landscape restores stereo
Wrist-hand companion connects at 60 Hz and completes 2-gesture calibration
Stereo VR hand mode renders the diegetic 3D gloved hand with zero DOM HUD
Extended arm rummaging opens the bin in 3 strokes without locking head gaze
Twisting the wrist rotates the 3D find and a sharp wave throws/discards it
Calmly lowering the hand downward saves the find into the collection
Right/Left wrist choice syncs bidirectionally and mirrors 2-bone elbow & glove anatomy
Reopening VR dialog auto-resumes granted gyro and updates companion link URL params
No page errors, console errors or failed HTTP responses
limitations: Synthetic gyro/marker inputs and SwiftShader do not certify physical axis signs, the real rear camera, or phone FPS.
